passage
progression
solution:

Explanation:

☛ The phrase "the ______ was endless" describes an interminable line, making queue the most appropriate choice.
☛ It functions as a collective noun, representing a group of people.
☛ Grammar Rule: Collective nouns (e.g., queue, team) take singular verbs when the group acts as one unit. Example: "The queue moves slowly."
